page.layout: One title page. Top: title in display type, "Andreæ Hy-" in large italic over "PERII COMPENDIVM" in spaced capitals, then "Physices Aristo-" over "teleæ.", then an italic line "Cum locuplete Rerum & uerbo-" over "rum memorabilium", then "INDICE." in spaced capitals. Centre: woodcut engraving. Below it: imprint "BASILEAE, EX OFFI-" over "cina Oporiniana, 1574." In the right margin, a handwritten ownership inscription.
page.notes: Engraving between the title and the imprint: a woodcut of a bearded, long-haired man standing on a sea creature or rock with waves beneath, holding a shell or horn-like object in one hand and a rod or vessel in the other, with a fish or animal at the left edge. Handwritten annotations in the right margin, not printed text, not transcribed: "Joannes Mauritius / Hilsberg Grimmensis / Misnicus. / ANNO / Dei et Mea / Carleus" (the last lines are only partly legible; "Dei et Mea" and "Carleus" are doubtful readings). Ink stain over the initial "A" of "Andreæ" and a small mark near the title's right side; not printed. The imprint line "1574" is set with spaced digits as printed.
